changelog: The app now tells you when a new version is out (Settings -> App updates to switch it off).

Deck analysis as a readable breakdown, including combos, bracket fit and Rule 0 to share with your table; Pro adds goldfish and the matchup gauntlet. An unchanged deck keeps its analysis, even offline.
Pull down on any tab to sync; photos your PC couldn't identify can be reviewed; wishlist shows the card and lets you remove what you added.
